senses.gloss: f.(b. h.; בָּרָה; v. בֵּירִית) prop. circle, ring, chain, hence oath (of fidelity), solemn injunction; covenant treatise. [כרת ב׳ to cut a ring out; to make a covenant; בא בב׳ to enter into the ring, to promise fidelity; הפר ב׳ to break the ring, to break one’s oath &c.] Sabb. 137ᵇ; בריתו של אברהם אבינו (sign of) the covenant of Abraham, circumcision.
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Peah 8:6:8">Y. Peah VIII, 21ᵃ</cite> <he>מפני ב׳ של א״א</he> on account of the covenant of Abraham (for the sake of human dignity).

<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 18">Num. R. s. 18</cite>, a. fr. <he>ב׳ כרותה לשפתים</he> a law is made for the lips, i.e. words are ominous (ref. to <he>לא נעלה</he>, <cite ref="Numbers 16:12">Num. XVI, 12</cite>).
Gen. R. s. 34, v. אָוִיר; a. fr.—הַבְּ׳ וכ׳ by the covenant (an oath), indeed.

<cite ref="Tosefta Challah 1:6">Tosef. Ḥall. I, 6</cite> <he>ב׳ וכ׳</he> (Var. <he>הב׳</he>); <cite ref="Pesachim 38b:12">Pes. 38ᵇ</cite> indeed, those are the very words &c.; (some explain) indeed?, are those the very &c. (is it a tradition for which no reason needs to be given)?; Y. Peah V, 19ᵇ bot. <he>הב׳</he>.—Pl. <he>בְּרִיתוֹת</he>.
Ber. 48ᵇ sq. שלש ב׳ three covenants (three times the word b’rith, Deut. XXVIII, 69; XXIX, 8).

<cite ref="Tosefta Sotah 8:10">Tosef. Sot. VIII, 10</cite>; <cite ref="Tosefta Sotah 8:11">11</cite> <he>ב׳</he> Var. (ed. Zuck. <cite ref="K01182"><he>כְּרִיתוֹת</he></cite>); <cite ref="Sotah 37b:6">Sot. 37ᵇ</cite>; a. fr.
